items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I remember 'A Hundred Years From Today' from Ella Waters -- Ethel Waters recorded it years ago.

ctx.x: It brings back a lot of memories.

Yeah, it brings back a lot of memories. And, of course, there's 'Every Time, Every Time I Fall In Love Again.' 'Georgia' -- after I did 'Georgia' on the Hoagy Carmichael album, that became pretty much part of my standard repertoire now. And, 'A Hundred Years From Today' -- boy, I remember 'A Hundred Years From Today' from Ella Waters -- Ethel Waters recorded it years ago. And I remember Mildred Bailey recording it. I've always liked 'A Hundred Years From Today.' And it has become a favorite now. And the rest are,…
